sources.entry: Wavelog - Webbased Logging Software for Radio Amateurs. Enhanced QSO logging, statistics and maps for your browser. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Wavelog is a self-hosted PHP web application for logging amateur radio contacts (QSOs) from any browser, forked from Cloudlog.
summary.what_it_does: Wavelog is a self-hosted PHP application for radio amateurs to log their contacts (QSOs) and access the logbook from any web browser with internet access. It is described as an enhanced fork of Cloudlog by MM9SQL. The README names a Docker setup using a prebuilt image and Docker Compose, plus a classic LAMP-stack install with Apache2 or nginx, PHP 8.2 to 8.5, and MySQL 8+ or MariaDB 10.11+. It is built on CodeIgniter 3 with Bootstrap 5. The README also points to WavelogGate, a separate tool for transferring CAT data from a radio rig to Wavelog, and to external documentation. A public demo instance is linked.
use_cases: send rig CAT data to a logbook
manage amateur radio contacts from a browser
how_to_run: Docker (easiest): get the prebuilt image and use Docker Compose, following the Docker guide linked in the README
Classic LAMP stack (recommended): install 64-bit Linux, Apache2 or nginx, PHP 8.2 to 8.5, and MySQL 8+ or MariaDB 10.11+
Follow the Linux Guide linked in the README for the LAMP install steps
notable: Enhanced fork of Cloudlog, with QSO logging, statistics and maps
Prebuilt Docker image with Docker Compose option
Companion WavelogGate tool for rig CAT data transfer
Documentation and translations maintained by a core dev team and many translators
caveats: Linux is highly recommended; Windows may work but 32-bit is no longer supported
Requires PHP 8.2 to 8.5 and MySQL 8+ or MariaDB 10.11+
The README says PRs are only accepted on the dev branch and must contain one feature or fix each
